description: Teach the line a number. Roles: approved (greeted as someone the owner knows), vip (treated as urgent, told the owner will see it right away), blocked (turned away before the line answers). No role connects a caller to the owner: the line takes the details and the owner gets the written summary.

notes.description: Context the line should have when this number calls or is called, up to 300 characters.

phone.description: Their phone number. US or Canada only, in any common format, e.g. '+14155550123' or '(415) 555-0123'.

role.description: approved (default), vip or blocked. See the tool description for what each does.

name: add_contact
title: Add a contact
